CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Smoothly return to center, level flight.
CONTROLS.NAME: recenter

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Forward flight speed in units per second.
CONTROLS.NAME: fly_speed

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How far the camera sees before fading to fog.
CONTROLS.NAME: draw_distance

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Minimum flight altitude — raise to fly above peaks, lower to thread valleys.
CONTROLS.NAME: min_height

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Scale of terrain features — higher = broader mountain ranges.
CONTROLS.NAME: terrain_scale

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Altitude where snow begins — lower values cover more of the mountain in snow.
CONTROLS.NAME: snow_line

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Moon azimuth — rotates the cold directional light around the mountains.
CONTROLS.NAME: moon_angle

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Overall brightness of the aurora ribbons.
CONTROLS.NAME: aurora_intensity

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Animation speed of the aurora bands.
CONTROLS.NAME: aurora_speed

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Rotate the aurora palette through the color spectrum.
CONTROLS.NAME: aurora_hue

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Blend of previous frame — motion trails and temporal smoothing.
CONTROLS.NAME: motion_blur

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How strongly bass flashes the maple leaf flags red.
CONTROLS.NAME: flag_glow

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How strongly bass pulses the aurora and flag glow.
CONTROLS.NAME: bass_reactivity

DESCRIPTION: Fly over snowy Canadian mountains at night. Aurora borealis ribbons glow above the peaks, Canada geese fly in V-formation, and maple leaf flags planted in the terrain flash red to the beat. Terrain inspired by Sirenian Dawn (nimitz). Aurora system adapted from Aurora Paint by Noztol.
TITLE: Aurora Canada
